stories.title: What's in store now the Big Burns Supper is no more?
stories.summary: The festival brought some big names to Dumfries but a new "winter extravaganza" is taking its place.

stories.title: Why is Scotland's housing shortage getting worse?
stories.summary: Homelessness has hit record levels and the cost of renting or buying property has continued to rise.

stories.title: Acquitted 'China spy': I was fall guy for security services
stories.summary: Thousands of messages seen by BBC show how a Chinese official sought details of sensitive political matters.

stories.title: Seven in hospital after car 'mounts pavement' in Glasgow
stories.summary: Police said the driver was assessed by paramedics and treated at the scene of the incident, which happened at about 15:45 on Hyndland Road.

stories.title: Edinburgh's Princes Street to fully reopen by end of year
stories.summary: The busy street was partially closed for seven weeks after a fire ripped through a building in July.

stories.title: Further BBC cuts could undermine funding model, union leader warns
stories.summary: A trade union leader has warned more cost-saving measures could prompt Scots to question why they pay the licence fee.

stories.title: Scottish Labour leader says the UK should re-join EU
stories.summary: Michael Marra said he wanted "solidarity, not separation" and accepted that "re-joining the EU won't be easy".

stories.title: US military aircraft landed at Prestwick Airport after leaving English base
stories.summary: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

stories.title: Cyber criminal orchestrated £2m crypto theft bid from jail cell
stories.summary: Robert Barr directed Sean Favier and Iain Doyle to steal the funds from two houses in Midlothian in 2024.

stories.title: Gang members jailed for plotting to kill drugs boss lose appeal
stories.summary: Last year crime boss David Nisbet, 36, was jailed for 13 years and Declan McCuish for 11 years for conspiring to kill drug leader Ryan Carvill.

stories.title: McTominay reveals heart treatment at World Cup
stories.summary: Scott McTominay reveals he received treatment on his heart two days before Scotland's World Cup win over Haiti in June.

stories.title: Should Aberdeen schools have 'winter cards' instead of Christmas cards?
stories.summary: An Aberdeen primary recently faced a backlash over its suggested terminology for cards.
